# ReplyRecvPort

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_docs.py in kagantmr/zuzu. Do not edit. -->

ReplyRecv() with the result unpacked.

!!! info "Library helper"
    Implemented in `zuzu.h` on top of the syscalls; it has no syscall number of its own.

```c
PortWaitResult ReplyRecvPort(uint32_t xlen, Handle grant_handle, Handle recv_port, Duration timeout);
```

## Parameters

| Name | Direction | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `xlen` | in | Reply length in bytes. |
| `grant_handle` | in | [Handle](../types.md#handle) to copy to the caller, or -1. |
| `recv_port` | in | Port to receive on, with PERM_WAIT. |
| `timeout` | in | Milliseconds to wait, or TIMEOUT_POLL / TIMEOUT_INFINITE. |

## Returns

The unpacked result; status as for ReplyRecv().
